title: Retail sales cleaning and EDA
brief: Clean the UCI Online Retail transactions (541,909 rows), handle cancellations, missing customer IDs and outliers, then explore revenue by country, product and month.
deliverable: Jupyter notebook on GitHub plus a one-page findings summary
rubric: Documented cleaning steps; at least 5 charts each answering a stated question; 3 findings with numbers; reproducible notebook
skill_names: pandas data wrangling | Data cleaning and quality | Exploratory data analysis | Python visualisation

title: City mobility KPI dashboard
brief: Load one month of NYC taxi trip records (Parquet) into a database, model them, and build a dashboard of trips, revenue, average fare and peak hours.
deliverable: Published Power BI or Looker Studio dashboard plus the SQL used
rubric: Correct KPIs verified against SQL; filters by date and zone; clear titles and labels; one insight annotated on the dashboard
skill_names: SQL joins and aggregation | Data visualisation principles | BI dashboards | Business metrics and KPIs
linked_phase_checkpoint: Project DA-P02 passes its rubric and A/B test quiz of at least 70%

title: Development indicators insight report
brief: Pick a question (for example, how education spending relates to outcomes across countries), pull World Bank indicators, analyse with SQL and Python, fit a simple regression, and recommend an action.
deliverable: Report of at most 4 pages and a 5-slide deck; code on GitHub
rubric: Clear question and answer up front; regression interpreted correctly with limitations; recommendation follows from evidence; repository readable
skill_names: Advanced SQL | Regression basics | Data storytelling | Git and version control
linked_phase_checkpoint: Project DA-P03 passes its rubric and a mock interview is passed
